nodes.title: Sequence Player (drag to orbit, space to play)
How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use

- One person, roughly in place. Slow hands and close-fitting clothing work best.
- Start with frames 0-20 and draft training, then increase the range and quality.
- Generation still processes the selected clip; a shorter training range only shortens export/training.

## Custom Nodes
- Mickmumpitz Nodes
- SplatKit - **Currently you can't install it via the manger. Follow the installation guide below**


---

## Installation

1.Download the Splatkit Custom Nodes installer here: [https://github.com/mickmumpitz/ComfyUI-SplatKit/releases/download/installer-1.0.0/install_splatkit.bat](https://github.com/mickmumpitz/ComfyUI-SplatKit/releases/download/installer-1.0.0/install_splatkit.bat)

2.Place it into your ComfyUI_windows_portable folder, where you also see run_nvidia.bat and the ComfyUI folder.

4.Run spaltkit_installer.bat. It installs the custom nodes and builds a self-contained Python 3.11 / CUDA 12.8 environment under the pack's bin/ folder — downloading uv and a gsplat wheel, then installing the pinned dependencies. It touches nothing in ComfyUI's own Python.

5.Restart ComfyUI. The Splat Backend Setup node should now report Ready.

nodes.title: Model Download Links
widgets_values:
## Important!
### You need to update the Mickmumpitznodes at least to version 1.5.7!

---

## Required Models (Models are automatically downloaded)

| Model file | 📁 Model folder under *ComfyUI/models* | Download Link |
|------|--------|---------|
| **model.safetensors** (4DAnyone) | /splatkit/4danyone | [https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/model.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/model.safetensors) |
| **Wan2.2_VAE.pth** | /splatkit/4danyone | [https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/Wan2.2_VAE.pth](https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/Wan2.2_VAE.pth) |
| **prompt_context.safetensors** | /splatkit/4danyone | [https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/prompt_context.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/prompt_context.safetensors) |
| **Wan22_TI2V_5B_Turbo_lora_rank_64_fp16.safetensors** (only with Turbo enabled) | /splatkit/4danyone | [https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/Wan22_TI2V_5B_Turbo_lora_rank_64_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/blob/main/4danyone/Wan22_TI2V_5B_Turbo_lora_rank_64_fp16.safetensors) |
| **imagenet-vgg-verydeep-19-conv.safetensors** (VGG-19 perceptual, only for Train Sequence) | /splatkit/4danyone | [https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/resolve/main/perceptual/imagenet-vgg-verydeep-19-conv.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/AntResearch/4DAnyone/resolve/main/perceptual/imagenet-vgg-verydeep-19-conv.safetensors) |
| **model.safetensors** (BiRefNet) | /splatkit/birefnet | [https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/model.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/model.safetensors) |
| **config.json** (BiRefNet — must sit alongside model) | /splatkit/birefnet | [https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/config.json](https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/config.json) |
| **birefnet.py** (BiRefNet — must sit alongside model) | /splatkit/birefnet | [https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/birefnet.py](https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/birefnet.py) |
| **BiRefNet_config.py** (BiRefNet — must sit alongside model) | /splatkit/birefnet | [https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/BiRefNet_config.py](https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet/blob/main/BiRefNet_config.py) |
| **sam_3d_body_dinov3_bf16.safetensors** (SAM 3D Body) | /detection | [https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam-3d-body/resolve/main/detection/sam_3d_body_dinov3_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam-3d-body/resolve/main/detection/sam_3d_body_dinov3_bf16.safetensors) |
